name: Python bytecode (.pyc) decompilation and control flow recovery
topic: Python bytecode (.pyc) decompilation and control flow recovery
description: Python bytecode (.pyc) decompilation and control flow recovery -- a easy-tier reverse engineering challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Python bytecode (.pyc) decompilation and control flow recovery"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is a hex-encoded XOR cipher (4-byte repeating key). Brute-force or crib-drag with the known flag prefix.
